questions.prompt: Where does kubeadm keep the cluster's certificates?
questions.explanation: The CA plus the API server, etcd and front-proxy certificates all live there.

questions.prompt: Write the kubeadm command that shows certificate expiry dates.
questions.explanation: `kubeadm certs renew all` renews them; the kubelet picks up the new files when the static Pods restart.

questions.prompt: Which sections make up a kubeconfig? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: A context is the pairing of a cluster and a user, with an optional default namespace - but there is no top-level namespaces section.

questions.prompt: A user submits a CertificateSigningRequest. What makes it usable?

options.text: An administrator approves it, then the signer issues the certificate

questions.explanation: `kubectl certificate approve <name>`, then read the issued certificate out of status.certificate.

questions.prompt: Where does RBAC get a client's username and groups from?

options.text: The certificate's CN for the user and O for the groups

questions.explanation: CN becomes the username and each O becomes a group - which is why creating a user is really just issuing a certificate.
